text:
alex: Heads-up — canary rollout for 0.21 was automatically paused by the perf gate. Observing ~18% p95 regression on long-context (8k+) traffic in eu cluster.
perf-bot: CI perf check failed: p95 +22% vs baseline on perf/inference-longcontext (run 1769001200). https://perf.redwood/internal/runs/1769001200
maria: Ugh. Any obvious suspects? Recent merges to kernel selector or batching heuristics?
sam: Quick profile from a canary host: CPU hot in kernel-choice dispatch. kernel-selector now preferring the new `batched-mmap` path; memcpy/copy_out overhead visible. Also KV cache hit rate dropped 94% -> 78% (evictions spiked).
jia: I think PR #4821 (commit 9f3b2a7) changed the KV eviction threshold to reduce memory. That landed in the same release.
alex: That KV tweak went in with the quantization fixes. Combined with the kernel path change it could explain extra copies and cache churn.
sam: Perf snippet: ```
perf summary:
p95 baseline: 120ms
p95 canary: 142ms
kv_hits: 94% -> 78%
kernel_choice: batched-mmap used 68% -> 92%
top stacks: memcpy, kernel_choice_dispatch, kv_lookup
```
maria: Can we bisect to confirm which change is dominant? Who owns the kernel-selector change?
sam: Bisect plan: revert kernel-selector change first (commit a1b2c3d) and run the longcontext suite. If regression persists, revert KV-ejection tweak. I can run `./tools/bisect_perf.sh --suite longcontext --metric p95` to automate.
ops-bot: Canary rollout paused by gate. Traffic shifted to fallback model variant for 2% of users. Alert posted to #canary.
jia: I'll queue a revert for the KV PR to a patch branch and redeploy to canary. ETA ~15m.
sam: Also propose we add a small CI perf test that simulates KV working set and asserts kv_hit_rate >= 90% and p95 delta < 10% so rollouts are gated in CI.
alex: Agreed. Also propose tightening auto-rollback policy: current rule checks 10m windows. Proposal: immediate rollback if (p95 delta > 12% for 5m) AND (kv_hit_rate delta > 10% OR kernel-choice shift > 20%). Thoughts?
maria: Sounds good but add hysteresis (require 2 consecutive windows) to avoid flapping from noisy signals.
sam: I'll draft the guardrail change and add a targeted micro-benchmark for 8k-context in presubmit. Also will prepare a fallback revert for kernel-selector.
jia: KV revert deploy started to canary (branch `kv-fix-1769`). Will post metrics once they stabilize.
perf-bot: Update: after reverting KV eviction change, p95 dropped to 123ms, kv_hits 92%. Still ~2-3% above baseline; kernel-choice change still contributing.
alex: Good progress. Keep canary paused. If p95 stays under 10% delta for 15m we'll consider resuming, but keep kernel-selector behind a feature flag for now.
sam: I'll dig into copy_count in `batched-mmap` and see if we can reduce extra copies; prepping a targeted revert as fallback.
maria: Thanks — will add follow-ups to the eng-runtime weekly. Assign sam/jia to own the remediation and CI gate.
alex: Filed the rollout ticket INF-1278 and linked this thread: https://jira.redwood/browse/INF-1278. Will update here as metrics change.
_notes: Slack thread captured as a single continuous message string; messages prefixed by sender display name. No title field as per agents.md.
